content:
Terms and Conditions

These Terms and Conditions apply to your use of the Youth Face website and purchases made through it. Please read them carefully before placing an order.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing this website or placing an order, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or place an order.

2. About Youth Face

Youth Face is an Indian skincare brand offering skincare products through this website. Youth Face is a brand operated by Beauty Mart. References to “we”, “us” and “our” mean Beauty Mart, operating the Youth Face brand.

3. Products and Product Information

We aim to present product information clearly on our website. Please review the product page, including ingredients, directions and other available information, before placing an order. Product images are for illustration and may vary slightly from the product received.

4. Orders and Order Acceptance

Submitting an order is a request to purchase the selected products. Order confirmation or payment confirmation does not by itself guarantee acceptance. We may contact you if further information is needed in relation to an order.

5. Pricing and Payments

Product prices and available payment options are shown on the website or at checkout. Please review your order details before completing payment. Any applicable charges shown at checkout form part of your order total.

6. Shipping and Delivery

Shipping and delivery information is provided on our Shipping & Delivery page. Delivery timing may depend on the destination, courier availability and other logistical factors.

7. Returns and Refunds

Returns and refund requests are handled in accordance with our Refund & Returns Policy. Please review that policy before requesting a return or refund.

8. Product Use and Cosmetic Disclaimer

Our products are cosmetic skincare products and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Use products only as directed. If you have concerns about suitability, sensitivity or an existing skin condition, consider seeking advice from an appropriate qualified professional before use. Stop use if you experience discomfort or irritation.

9. Website Content and Intellectual Property

The content on this website, including text, images, product information, branding and design, is for personal and non-commercial use only. You must not copy, reproduce, modify or use website content without prior written permission from Youth Face.

10. Customer Responsibilities

You are responsible for providing complete and accurate order, delivery and contact information. Please check your order details carefully before submitting an order and contact us promptly if you need assistance.

11. Limitation of Liability

To the extent permitted by applicable law, Youth Face will not be liable for indirect, incidental or consequential loss arising from use of this website or products purchased through it. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

12. Privacy and Personal Information

Our handling of personal information is described in our Privacy Policy. By using this website, you acknowledge that your information may be handled as described in that policy.

13. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. The version published on this page applies to your use of the website at that time.
